info.name: CropDeal Platform API
info.description: Complete microservices API collection for CropDeal backend including Price Alerts, Delivery, Reviews, Mandi sync.

item.name: Create Dealer Buying Request (Triggers Farmer Alert)

request.description: Farmer creates a live crop auction session with base price and end time.
Discover all active live crop auctions ordered by ending soonest.
Retrieve details and current highest bid for an auction session.
Get all auctions created by a specific farmer.
Dealer places bid. Checks wallet balance, escrows funds, and refunds any previously outbid dealer automatically.
Get chronological bid history for a specific auction session.
Get all bids placed by a specific dealer.

item.name: Farmer - Close and Award Auction Session

request.description: Farmer awards auction to highest bidder; automatically settles payout to farmer wallet.
Farmer cancels auction; automatically refunds held funds to active highest bidder.
Top up wallet balance for a dealer or farmer.
Get current wallet balance and transaction ledger.
Debit or hold funds from user wallet.
Credit or refund funds back into user wallet.
